This book was created through a collaboration between Third Story Project and The Asia Foundation. The Third Story Project creates and produces children’s books in Burmese and other Myanmar languages to distribute free of charge to children around Myanmar. The stories are written and illustrated by Myanmar artists for a Myanmar audience and address issues of peace, tolerance, diversity, gender, environment, and child rights.
